parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Ultrafiltration in the kidney takes place between the glomerulus and the Bowman's capsule. The afferent blood vessel carrying blood to the glomerulus has a wider lumen than the efferent blood vessel.

Explain why the lumen of the afferent blood vessel needs to be wider than the lumen of the efferent blood vessel.

parts.label: (b)
(b)(ii)
parts.text: Describe the roles of **A** and **B** in the formation of the glomerular filtrate.
